title: Provisioning a charter yacht: food, water and life aboard
lead: A week on a charter yacht runs smoothly on a good shopping list, enough water and a fridge that stays cold. Here is how to plan meals, shop, stow food and cook safely for a week afloat in Greece.
description: Provisioning a charter yacht for a week in Greece: meal plans, shopping quantities, drinking water, tank water, fridge and ice, stowing food, personal kit, cooking at sea, rubbish and cash.
summary: Plan breakfast and lunch on board and some dinners ashore, with one simple dinner in reserve.
Drink bottled water, about 2 to 3 litres per person per day, and keep the tank water for washing.
Keep the fridge full and shut, and buy fresh food every two or three days in harbour.
Stow everything as if the boat is about to heel, and never boil pans under way in a rough sea.
